Maya Rivera: Heads up — Clearwave on‑prem annual invoice INV-CLW-2026-04 looks wrong. Platform fee appears twice, neting a $48,750 discrepancy. Need guidance on how to correct (credit memo vs corrected invoice). Snippet below.

Maya Rivera: ```INV-CLW-2026-04
- On‑prem license (12mo)     $120,000
- Platform fee (annual)       $36,000
- Platform fee (annual)      -$36,000  <- duplicate line?
- Support (Gold)              $18,500
TOTAL                        $138,500
```

Marcus Lee: Ack. Do we have the signed SOW showing any platform fee waiver or manual credits from last year? @jonas can you check the true‑up history? :eyes:

Jonas Patel: I pulled meter/true‑up logs. System billed platform fee once. Accounting team processed a manual reversal credit on 2025-11-02 (reason: legacy migration credit). Looks like that reversal was applied to the old invoice but then the invoicing system re‑issued the annual platform line when generating 2026 invoice. So both a manual credit and a fresh charge exist.

Jonas Patel: Recommendation: issue a credit memo for the accidental duplicate credit line (so net matches what we expected) and avoid refund if possible by applying to next invoice. Need approval from finance leadership.

Ava Chen: Legal ok with credit memo + explanatory note referencing the 2025 reversal. Keep the memo language explicit about "duplicate accounting adjustment" and include the original reversal date. That protects RW if customer disputes.

Maya Rivera: Agree — finance prefers credit memo + offset on next renewal rather than refunding cash. @finn any objections? CFO asked to minimize cash movement.

Finn Turner: Finance prefers offset too, but contract clause 9.2 permits refunds within 60 days of payment. We need customer consent to apply credit forward; if they refuse, we have to issue a refund.

Marcus Lee: Customer paid on 2026-03-30 via card (we have receipt). I messaged the Clearwave billing contact asking whether they'd accept the credit applied to next year's invoice.

Marcus Lee: Customer reply (via email): "We'll accept the credit applied to next renewal. Please send the credit memo for our records and confirm the amount."

Maya Rivera: Great — proceed with credit memo. Jonas, can you draft credit memo and tag @billing-bot for tracking? Use memo reference CM-CLW-190234. Include note: "Duplicate accounting reversal + reinstate net charge; credit applied to next renewal per customer instruction."

Jonas Patel: Will draft now. Billing bot, please create internal ticket and mark as "manual review completed" when memo uploaded.

billing-bot: Created ticket FIN-BILL-2026-190234. Upload the drafted credit memo to the ticket and set status to "awaiting ops". :white_check_mark:

Maya Rivera: Once ticket is ready, I'll route to Accounts Receivable for posting and update the customer with a signed copy. Thanks team. :pray:
